title: Finite-cube monomial agreement
statement: For a natural number $n$, a finite set $S$ of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and a sign assignment $x$ on those coordinates, the indexed monomial on $S$ equals the monomial on the finite sign cube on $n$ coordinates.
